Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a widened mediastinum without significant deviation or narrowing of the tracheal air column, which is most consistent with mediastinal lymphoma among the provided choices. Other options describe specific displacements (anterior bowing, posterior displacement, lateral displacement) or locations (anterior only) that are not supported by the visible midline trachea and diffuse mediastinal widening.
